info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v2-spec
info.description: The Deny Insurance Claims API allows authorized users to efficiently manage the denial of insurance claims. This endpoint facilitates the process of denying specific claims based on provided identifiers, ensuring that claims are handled in accordance with operational procedures. Typical consumers include insurance adjusters and claims administrators who require a streamlined method to track and update the status of claims. This API promotes effective communication and record management within insurance processing workflows.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to deny a specific claim. Upon successful execution, the status of the claim will be updated to reflect its denial.

requestBody.description: Request body for denying a claim. This body should contain the necessary information to process the deny operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the claim has been denied.
